# RustyNES v3.4.2 — "Keystone"

A one-fix patch release on v3.4.1 "Beacon": the RustyNES core in RetroArch loads on Apple Silicon Macs again. Nothing in the emulation core, the desktop, web and mobile apps or the MiSTer core changes. Movies, netplay sessions and save states from v3.4.1 are compatible (epoch 5, protocol 9).

## Fixed

- **The RetroArch core on Apple Silicon Macs.** Loading RustyNES from RetroArch's Online Updater froze RetroArch and dropped it back to the shell, for at least the last few releases; the RustyNES desktop app was not affected. libretro's build template strips the core after linking, which on arm64 leaves the linker's code signature no longer matching the file, and macOS kills any process that loads arm64 code with a broken signature. In the buildbot's core of 2026-10-20, 101 of its 538 signed pages did not match; natively built C cores on the same server checked clean. The arm64 build is no longer stripped, so its signature ships intact, and a test keeps that setting from being dropped. Intel Macs were not affected (an x86_64 core carries no signature).

## Getting the fixed core

RetroArch downloads cores from libretro's nightly build of RustyNES's `main` branch, not from this release page. The fixed core is on the buildbot within about a day of this release. A core you already downloaded stays installed, so **re-download RustyNES in RetroArch's Online Updater (Core Downloader)** to replace it.

## The MiSTer core

- **No new bitstreams.** This release attaches v3.4.1's two bitstreams byte for byte under v3.4.2 names, so the MiSTer menu still shows build date 261019: `RustyNES_MiSTer-v3.4.2.rbf` (off-die, the headline, md5 `474fa68f3f7888aaa6214e74aace2aa8`) and `RustyNES_MiSTer-v3.4.2-lite.rbf` (on-die, md5 `ca92523115ee9d864ce20c13a66a7eb7`).
- **Release candidate, not hardware-verified.** No hardware has run either bitstream.

## Verification

- **Tested on a Mac by the maintainer** (MacBook Pro, M5 Max, macOS 27.0.1, 2026-10-20): the buildbot's own arm64 core of 2026-10-20, with only its code signature repaired (ad-hoc, 0 of 538 pages mismatched), loads in RetroArch, where the unrepaired file had killed it. Same code, signature fixed: that isolates the signature as the cause.
- `libretro_buildbot_audit` pins the setting in the arm64 job's own `variables`; deleting it fails the test.
- The release audits (anchors, state prose, notes rendering, the libretro `.info`) pass on the bumped tree.

## Install

- Download the pre-built binaries for Linux, macOS, and Windows below.
- The MiSTer bitstreams are attached below as a release candidate, not hardware-verified: `RustyNES_MiSTer-v3.4.2.rbf` (off-die, needs SDRAM) and `RustyNES_MiSTer-v3.4.2-lite.rbf` (on-die).
- The WebAssembly build is live at [doublegate.github.io/RustyNES](https://doublegate.github.io/RustyNES/).
- The RetroArch core is in RetroArch's Online Updater on the platforms the libretro buildbot publishes to.
